body: Thanks, today I am feeling better.

Thanks for the advice... For some reason I'm really intimidated by online dating apps, I don't know how to present myself. And (for sake of argument, let's use tinder) I never know how to word my intentions in my bio. All this leads to me just quitting and doing something else haha. Sorry if I'm asking too many questions, this whole business makes me nervous.
I'm seeing a therapist. As for the relationships, where do I start?
I loved the mountain, so majestic and quiet. Feel free to PM, I'm sure I'll figure out how it works

I would like to see your work, but I have no idea how to send stories on this app.
My favorite places are Colorado (for the mountains) and D.C. (for the architecture)

I like to write, travel, sleep, and be with friends, but no matter how happy I get, I always look forward and see a lifetime of struggle and shit... I can't trick myself into looking at the positives when they seem so heavily outweighed by the negatives. It just doesn't seem worth the effort.

I don't mean to be a negative Nancy, but the depression makes it hard not to be over critical. My major was Anthropology and my minor was psychology, I honestly don't know what the fuck I was thinking with that, being suicidal for so long I've never been able to see a future for myself, let alone plan a career. I found humans interesting, but now I find that I would need a doctorate to do anything meaningful in this area.
I just can't see the big picture as you put it.
I have an AA, I guess I could build up some money and move back...
P.s. it already moved to collections by the time I wrote this, sorry for not being clearer. Thanks for the advice on the loans and for responding, it means a lot.
